title: The Round Face That Counts the Day

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Watching a shadow stick, a scholar wonders whether distant people carry small objects that tell the time.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Watching a shadow stick, (name1), a scholar, wonders whether distant people might carry small objects with round faces and turning arms that tell them the time.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The scholar sketches a circle with pointing arms; a child asks why anyone would need to know the time so exactly.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A builder imagines it made of metal and tiny wheels, and admits it sounds impossibly fiddly.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A villager imagines never being late again; another imagines always being reminded that they are late.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder wonders whether people who watch time so closely might forget to watch the sky.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village agrees the sun is a good enough clock for Isola.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A teenager secretly wishes for such a device so they would stop missing supper.
